candidate_generation: One shared fixed-scale reread per native predicted table; same candidate forV7.2/3/4; no formula intervention

parser.implementation: Python HTMLParser, convert_charrefs=True; exactly one table, explicit matched tr/td/th boundaries; no implicit HTML repair
parser.normalization: NFC Unicode and collapsed whitespace within cells; case retained; tags inside cells contribute their text; br contributes a space
parser.canonical_form: Compact JSON nested physical rows, each cell [rowspan,colspan,normalized_text]; header tag/style omitted
parser.spans: Positive integer spans<=1000; track occupied logical grid, reject overlap or rowspan beyond parsed rows; max logical columns<=1000
parser.rows: Count explicit tr rows; columns=max occupied logical extent respecting spans; cells=count physical td/th
parser.empty_fraction: Empty normalized physical cells / all physical cells
parser.duplicate_fraction: Equal text among horizontally adjacent physical cells where both are nonempty / all such pairs; zero if none
parser.limits: 100000 input characters and400 parsed rows; violations or unknown/malformed structures retain native
parser.simple_rule: Common validity and both structures known; same rows and max logical columns; candidate empty/duplicate fractions no larger than native plus1e-12

geometry_density: First10 pre-reread V6 native-region features; extraction unchanged
difference_features: Candidate minus native for rows,columns,cells,empty fraction,duplicate fraction,log1p canonical character count
missing_behavior: Zero placeholders with valid flags for training rows; unknown required geometry/structure means deployment keep; all112 prescribed rows retained in fitting
preprocessing: None; no data-fitted normalization or imputation

training.folds: 5; source-group SHA256 ascending then round-robin modulo5; frozen before fitting

margin_selection: Max training OOF retained region-macro TEDS; within1e-6 fewer accepted raw-content-changing replacements, then larger margin. Same common/unknown fallback as deployment.
validation: Existing29 table rows used once after freeze for development report only; no tuning/refit
old_test_and_benchmark: Excluded from fitting, feature selection, normalization, threshold selection and development comparison

fresh_confirmation.sampling: Pinned audited table release; deterministic source selection independent of recognition quality; freeze manifest before OCR
fresh_confirmation.gate: All128 valid dispositions;V7.4 mean exceeds highest control mean by>=.005; pairedV7.4-V7.2 document-bootstrap95% lower bound>0

gpu_policy.bind: Freshly verified idle GPU1-7 UUIDs only
